Biomimetic Design and Mechanical Properties of Additively Manufactured Titanium Alloy Implant with Gradient Gyroid Structure

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Runze Li, Chenchen Tian, Zikui Wu, Yi Lu Materials 2026-09-07 10.3390/ma19173806
单位: Key Laboratory of High Efficiency and Clean Mechanical Manufacture of Ministry of Education, Shandong University, Jinan 250061, China
通讯: Chenchen Tian @ Key Laboratory of High Efficiency and Clean Mechanical Manufacture of Ministry of Education, Shandong University, Jinan
相关性: 该论文直接涉及增材制造钛合金多孔支架的梯度设计、力学性能与应力匹配，与您的AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
边界: 该论文未报告疲劳性能、表面粗糙度或体内骨整合数据，仅涵盖静态力学测试和有限元分析。
动机· 传统钛合金支架缺乏多孔结构且弹性模量过高，导致骨整合差。
方法· 设计三种均匀孔隙率50%的Gyroid梯度支架，优化SLM工艺并制备，结合力学测试与FEA评估。
结果· 二次函数梯度设计实现10-30 GPa模量匹配和足够强度，满足承重骨支架要求。
验证· 通过SLM制备、显微组织表征、拉伸压缩测试及FEA验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Conventional titanium alloy bone scaffolds lack porous architecture and exhibit excessive elastic modulus, impairing osseointegration.
Method· Three biomimetic Gyroid scaffolds with uniform 50% porosity but different gradient profiles (uniform, linear, quadratic) were designed, fabricated via optimized SLM, and evaluated through mechanical testing and FEA.
Result· The quadratic gradient design achieved optimal modulus matching (10–30 GPa) and adequate strength, demonstrating potential for load-bearing bone scaffolds.
Validation· Validation included SLM process optimization, microstructural characterization, tensile and compressive tests, and finite element analysis.

Fringe projection profilometry as calibration and validation benchmark for physics-informed surrogate modeling of thermoelastic out-of-plane deformation

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation UQ
Mishraim Sanchez Torres, Ismael Hernández-Capuchin, José Luis Javier Sánchez-González, Cristina Ramírez-Fernández, Eddie Clemente et al. Measurement Science and Technology 2026-08-26 10.1088/1361-6501/ae9ee5
单位: Tecnologico Nacional de Mexico
相关性: 该论文展示了物理信息神经网络在热弹性变形预测中的校准与验证方法，其框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建与验证。
边界: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics applications, lacks contact mechanics and patient-specific geometry, and does not involve uncertainty quantification in the context of implant design.
动机· 为物理信息代理模型提供可复现的校准与独立验证基准。
方法· 结合Kirchhoff-Love板理论生成合成数据，用FPP标定边界条件，训练PINN并嵌入物理量。
结果· PINN在内部测试集R²=0.9996，外部验证误差低于FEM。
验证· 采用FPP测量三个热状态下的位移场进行外部验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To establish a reproducible metrological benchmark for calibrating and validating physics-informed surrogate models of thermoelastic deformation.
Method· A three-stage framework integrates Kirchhoff-Love plate theory for synthetic data generation, FPP-based calibration of boundary condition factor, and training of a residual PINN with physics-informed inputs and curriculum learning.
Result· The PINN achieves high accuracy on internal tests and outperforms FEM on external FPP validation at lower thermal states, with residual errors at the highest state attributed to plate theory linearization.
Validation· External validation was performed using fringe projection profilometry displacement maps at three thermal states, with measurement uncertainty characterized.

相关性: 该论文展示了代理模型辅助的多目标优化流程，可迁移至植入物设计中的应力屏蔽与稳定性优化。
边界: 该论文未涉及生物医学植入物、骨-植入物界面力学或临床验证，仅针对工业洗衣机结构优化。
动机· 解决洗衣机脱水阶段振动大、承载件可靠性不足及轻量化与动态性能平衡难题。
方法· 集成动力学建模、有限元仿真与Kriging代理模型，进行多目标优化。
结果· 箱体和内筒分别减重11.0%和9.8%，共振峰值振幅降低58%。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The paper addresses the challenge of severe vibration during dehydration, insufficient reliability of load-bearing components, and the trade-off between lightweight design and dynamic performance in industrial washing machines.
Method· A comprehensive workflow integrating Lagrange-based dynamic modeling, rigid-flexible coupling and refined finite element simulations, and Kriging surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization is proposed.
Result· The optimization achieved an 11.0% weight reduction in the cabinet and a 9.8% mass reduction in the inner cylinder while maintaining stress and frequency constraints, and reduced the resonance peak amplitude by 58%.
Validation· The results were validated through simulation-based comparisons of stress, frequency, and vibration responses before and after optimization.

动机· 研究SLM制备AlSi12Mg合金表面缺陷对性能的影响，探索后处理工艺优化。

Motivation· To investigate the combined effects of heat treatment, grinding, and ultrasonic-assisted magnetic abrasive finishing on the surface integrity and tribological performance of SLM-fabricated AlSi12Mg components.
Method· Systematically applied sequential post-processing treatments (HT, grinding, UAMAF) and characterized surface roughness, microstructure, hardness, corrosion resistance, and wear behavior using SEM, XRD, and tribological tests.
Result· The hybrid finishing approach dramatically reduced surface roughness by 97.7%, lowered the coefficient of friction by 69.6%, and decreased wear rate by 68.6%, while also reducing corrosion rates by over 90%.
Validation· Validation was performed through mechanical testing (microhardness, wear tests) and microstructural analysis (SEM, XRD) comparing as-built and treated samples.
